# InkImage

## Intent

- image display
- thumbnail
- click-to-expand media

## Prefer When

- An image needs package-consistent loading, error, and expandable viewing behavior.
- A compact thumbnail should open a larger view.

## Avoid When

- A decorative image needs only native img behavior.
- The media is not an image or needs a dedicated gallery workflow.

## Compose With

`InkLoading`, `InkPlaceholder`, `InkPopup`

## Public API Facts

- Import: `import { InkImage } from "@inkcre/ui-web";`

### Models

- `v-model:expanded` → `update:expanded` `[_value: boolean]`

## API Caveats

- 缩略图为原生按钮，alt/title 提供名称。v-model:expanded 可受控，省略则内部管理。
- InkScrim 提供模态、Escape 和焦点恢复；图片区空白点击关闭，图片及槽内容点击不关闭。
- 默认适应图片区；滚轮、双指、按钮和键盘连续缩放至 800%，100% 只是快捷比例；拖动浏览，双击 / 双点切换细节与全图。打开或更换 src 复位，长说明和扩展区域独立滚动，操作区固定。

## Common Mistakes

- Do not enable expansion when the source cannot provide a useful larger view.
